verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions natively supports defining CI/CD pipelines as YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions syntax, and community evidence confirms real-world usage of Gitea with CI tooling (Drone) alongside its native Actions feature. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Gitea Actions YAML workflows (most community evidence discusses Drone/Woodpecker as external CI rather than native Actions), and no detailed documentation excerpt showing workflow file structure/examples.
